cEkena naraH pUto hariM vrajet ॥” skAnde । “daRqapraRAmaM kurute vizRave BaktiBAvitaH । reRusaMKyaM vaset svarge SatamanvantaraM naraH ॥” tatrEva SrIkfzRanAradasaMvAde । “praRamya daRqavadBUmO namaskAreRa yo'rccayet । sa yAM gatimavApnoti na tAM kratuSatErapi ॥ namaskAreRa cEkena naraH pUto hariM vrajet ॥” tatrEva SivomAsaMvAde । “BUmimApIqya jAnuByAM Sira AropyavE Buvi । praRamet yo hi deveSaM so'SvameDaPalaM laBet ॥” tatrEvAnyatra । “tIrTakowisahasrARi tIrTakowiSatAni ca । nArAyaRapraRAmasya kalAM nArhanti zoqaSIm ॥ SAWyenApi namaskAraM kurvvataH SArNgaDanvine । SatajanmArjjitaM punareti janma kfzRapraRAmI na punarBavAya ॥” BaktisuDodaye । “vizRordaRqapraRAmArTaM Baktena patatA Buvi । pAtitaM pAtakaM kftsnaM nottizWati punaH saha ॥ api pApaM durAcAraM naraM tvatpraRataM hare
